primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

wikipediaRead.title: Shecaniah
wikipediaRead.locator: Article lines 103–107: identifies Shecaniah as one of the priests assigned to distribute daily portions, citing 2 Chronicles 31:15.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版記事は、歴代誌下31:15で配給を担った祭司の一人としてシェカニヤを挙げています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: Article lines 103–107: identifies Shecaniah as one of the priests assigned to distribute daily portions, citing 2 Chronicles 31:15.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 割当候補名と固定WEBの当該節を照合。語形や肩書だけで別人物とは結び付けず、当該節で明示される関係に限定。
